name: Harness Skills
description: Every message: the agent picks a lane (small, medium or full) before its first edit.

action.text: Before your first edit, pick a lane from the request and state it in one line: "Lane: small | medium | full — reason". small (a typo, a one-liner, an obvious bug, a copy tweak): do it and verify, with no workflow stages. medium (a bounded fix or tweak across a few files, no new feature): implement it yourself, then run the enabled review and security review stages, with no scout and no planner or approval. full (a new view, new functionality, a refactor, a data, storage or architecture change, or unclear scope): load the us-run-workflow skill (Harness Skills) and run its full lane: scout research, planner with approval, implementation by workers, reviews, release assessment and memory.
